note: Every legacy scan guard bound to the corpus root its ASSERTIONS consume. The empty-mirror oracle empties exactly that root and requires the guard to go red. A guard whose corpus is a directory it created itself does not belong here — it has no repo corpus to be vacuous about. Parity with tools/dev/anti-vacuity-burndown.json is enforced by tests/unit/_arch/anti-vacuity-burndown-ratchet.test.ts.
